descr: Qwen3.8-Max vs GLM-5.3: the two models are about even in blind Arena voting.
risposta: The blind Arena votes show the two models are essentially tied. GLM-5.3 scored 1481 while Qwen3.8-Max scored 1484, a difference of only three points. That gap is considered too close to call, so neither model clearly outperforms the other overall.
dimensioni: GLM-5.3 weighs in at 753.3 B total, with 50.2 B active parameters, and its 4-bit version requires about 458 GB to download. Qwen3.8-Max does not publish its size, so no download estimate is available.
velocita: Both models exceed the memory limits of typical high-end consumer GPUs. GLM-5.3 does not fit on RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, or Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB. Qwen3.8-Max also cannot fit on any of those machines, meaning both are only usable through online services.
gratisA: GLM-5.3 can be used for free by downloading the open-weight checkpoint and running it at home under an MIT license. The model is not available for a free trial on FreeLLMArena.
gratisB: Qwen3.8-Max offers a free trial quota on Alibaba Cloud for 90 days, but the weights are proprietary and it cannot be downloaded for local use. It also cannot be tried on FreeLLMArena.
sceglieA: Pick GLM-5.3 if you need an open-weight model that you can run locally under a permissive MIT license. It is suitable for users who can provision the large storage needed for the 4-bit download.
sceglieB: Pick Qwen3.8-Max if you prefer a proprietary model with a short-term free cloud trial and do not plan to run the model on personal hardware. It may be attractive for developers who want quick access without handling massive files.

categorie.Chat: In the Chat category GLM-5.3 scored 1481 and Qwen3.8-Max scored 1484, a difference of three points that the Arena judges as about even. Both models perform similarly for conversational tasks.
categorie.WebDev (coding): For coding assistance Qwen3.8-Max leads with a score of 1673 against GLM-5.3’s 1623. The gap suggests Qwen3.8-Max is the stronger choice for programming-related queries.
